title: Grab Ugreen’s ultra-compact 25W magnetic wireless charger for half off today
content:
Macworld

Ugreen MagFlow 25W foldable charger

View Deal

Whether you’re packing for a weekend trip or headed out for a day at the office, this tiny Ugreen MagFlow 25W foldable pocket-sized charger needs to be in your bag. And today, instead of shelling out $60, you can grab one for $30, half-off its MSRP and the best price we’ve ever seen.

This foldable charger will fit into the palm of your hand. It’s small enough to slip into a pocket. At 2.36 x 2.96 x 0.52 inches and just 3.88 ounces, it fits easily in a backpack or tech pouch. When unfolded, however, it will charge two of your devices at the same time. It fits your iPhone and AirPods just fine, so you’re always having fun listening to your favorite music. The 2-in-1 design takes things one step further. Lay it flat on your nightstand, or fold it into a stand on your desk if you want to check out a recipe or take a video call.

As small as it is, the Ugreen device comes with Qi2.2 certification and delivers up to 25W magnetic wireless charging. Ugreen says that takes an iPhone 17 Pro Max from 0-50 percent in just 30 minutes. This isn’t a power bank, so you’ll have to keep it plugged in, but you’ll have to use your own 45W or higher adapter since the Ugreen MagFlow 25W wireless charger doesn’t come with one.

So if you want a portable, versatile way to charge your gadgets without spending a fortune, grab this super cute wireless charger for $30 while it’s still on sale.
